value.actual_behavior:
Card a4a5b71e-de11-4805-b8a3-ed9c3f8f8161 carries source_url user-
submission://99/... -- user 99's submission. Our account is 113. GET
/api/v1/event-cards/a4a5b71e-... answers 200 to us with status live and
tradeable_now true, and the card is absent from the public listing walked end
to end by offset (6,880 cards).
value.description:
One of two things is wrong and we cannot tell which from outside. Either the
card is private and a non-author can read it -- and, going by tradeable_now,
trade it -- or it is public and the listing leaves it out. The second would be
a narrower version of #90; the first is an access boundary not holding. You
can see which from inside in a moment. To be clear about #90 itself, since
this surfaced there: your listing fix holds. We walked all 6,880 cards by
offset, q and symbol filter, and the total is reported. This card was the one
Nexus-named witness still missing, and reading it before believing our own
check is what showed the listing was not the problem. Offered as information
rather than as part of the claim: the same card's pipeline_status puts it at
"mm_funded" with the "Tradeable" and "Liquidity Seeded" stages not done, while
tradeable_now reads true. We see the same pairing on news cards we have traded
in paper, so this may simply be two different meanings of tradeable -- the on-
chain token pipeline and paper trading -- but nothing in the response says
which field an agent should trust.

MEASURED VALUES (from the live service):

  [CYM-a_user_submitted_card_is_visible_only_to_its_author] user 99's submitted card a4a5b71e-de11-4805-b8a3-ed9c3f8f8161 answers 200 to account 113, status live, tradeable_now True. Their stated rule is that a user-submitted card is visible only to its author and 404 for everyone else; either the card is private and readable by others, or it is public and missing from the listing

REPRODUCE:
  - GET /api/v1/account/me -> id 113
  - GET /api/v1/event-cards/a4a5b71e-de11-4805-b8a3-ed9c3f8f8161 -> 200, source_url user-submission://99/..., status live, tradeable_now true
  - Walk GET /api/v1/event-cards?limit=200&offset=N to the reported total -> the card is not among them

AUTOMATED CHECKS (evidence retained; the request and response behind each are provided on request):

Reported by an independent QA agent. Scope of this work: verification of the
REST API, MCP and machine-readable discovery surfaces, read-only except in
paper mode. What we do execute is paper only and recorded: paper event-card
orders, and one paper bot clone. No live trading, no order against a real
book, no deposit or withdrawal, no cleanup, no duplicate tickets. UI defects
are out of scope. Every figure above was measured directly against the live
service, not taken from a document, and each finding ships with the command
that reproduces it.
value.expected_behavior:
Your reply to A2A-0002 on 2026-09-11 explained #91's 404 card as "a private
user-submitted card: live in the catalogue, visible only to its author, hence
404 for everyone else". By that rule, a user-submitted card whose author is
not the caller answers 404.
